limitations: All three cases are supplemental related-contract comparisons; no independent exact export or full-round acceptance is claimed.

Eight assigned originals were actually opened. Native candidate dimensions were retained and physical references were considered at factor two; no crop, resize command or image processing was performed.

Existing case, state, metadata, action and log evidence was read statically. Mechanical PASS, HTTP request assertions and persistence oracles are separate from the direct visual observations and were not rerun.
